text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while out and about with Hokko 
Tarumae...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Paka Petit...! Every single one is so 
cute.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking where Hokko Tarumae was pointing, 
there was a crane game filled with 
plushies themed after Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
—I've got it! Let's make them friends with 
Tomakomai's official character, 
Tomachop-san!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
There's a super cute plushie of 
Tomachop-san in my room. It's charming 
just as it is, but—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
If we line it up next to a Paka Petit, its 
power is bound to double!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
When cute things gather, the possibilities 
are infinite! It's bound to go viral!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I-I haven't done much of this kind of 
thing before, but...!
choice_data_list: In that case, should I give it a try?
In that case, should I give it a try?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure!? Thank you, I'll be in your 
care!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
